title.full: Why Singpass asks for face verification

summary.text: It is an extra safeguard against unauthorised use of your Singpass account for transactions that require Singpass.

details.heading: Why you are prompted
details.body: Singpass Face Verification is an additional safeguard against unauthorised usage of your Singpass account on transactions that require Singpass.

details.heading: Need more information
details.body: Contact the Singpass Helpdesk directly for more information on Singpass Face Verification.
